comparison.objective: Break and recover four insert tangs; record releases a disc from a spring hub and inserts it into a console slot.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate aligns a narrow mandrel, regulates hammer impact, and retrieves tiny fragments; record coordinates hub depression with edge grasp, reorients a thin disc, and performs close-clearance slot insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four fractures, four tangs in a tray, retained inserts, and no damage; record requires hub release and a centered upright insertion deep enough for drive capture, without dropping the disc. Candidate fracture/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Release-plus-thin-object insertion is a meaningfully different tested ability from impact-driven notch fracture and fragment containment.
